name: Player and original rescued Dar-Ma leave Caverns through inn ladder

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ChorrolNorthernGoodsAndTrade::ref=0x0280fa::side=south
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=hackdirt-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during cavern exit')
 local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x280fa))
 if a and a:isValid() then
  assert(not Actor.isDead(a),'Dar-Ma died during cavern exit')
  print('EscortExit darmaCell='..a.cell.name..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(a).current..' position='..tostring(a.position))
 end
 print('EscortExit playerCell='..self.cell.name..' position='..tostring(self.position))
 if core.isWorldPaused() then print('EscortExit paused');return end
 if self.cell.name=='HackdirtMoslinsInn' then
  print('EscortExit playerInInn')
  if a and a:isValid() and a.cell.name==self.cell.name then print('EscortExit followerInInn') end
  return
 end
 local door=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90cf1));assert(door and door:isValid(),'Original cavern ladder missing')
 local target=door.position;local v=target-self.position
 local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 local c=target-camera.getPosition();local pitch=-math.atan2(c.z,math.sqrt(c.x*c.x+c.y*c.y))
 if math.abs(angle)<0.05 and math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<0.04 then print('EscortExit ready') end
 print(string.format('EscortExit aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*128+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*128+.5)))))
end}}}}
